scope: Descriptive equal-run endpoint deltas; no acceptance verdict. Cache histograms are recorded once per completed task and count offered updates across passes, including retries. Process calls can visit many tries. These aggregates do not recover per-sort batch sizes, unique keys, or pure CPU time.
count_skew_scope: No adjustments are made. Separate histogram observations and scrape endpoints are not atomic; one-observation discrepancies are retained as boundary uncertainty, not treated as identical sampled tasks.
